notablePrerequisites:
Patrol Signaler does not have summoning sickness.
Paradise Mantle attached to Patrol Signaler.
description:
Activate Patrol Signaler by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Patrol Signaler by paying {1}{W} and untapping it, creating a 1/1 Kithkin Soldier creature token.
When the Kithkin Soldier enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers.
Holding priority, activate Patrol Signaler by tapping it, adding {W}.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
